name: Russian Hackers Life
overview: Russian hackers Fedor, Boris and Ignat are going to hack the world in the name of digital freedom, equality and fraternity under the total control and leadership of Fedor. There is only one problem: to achieve their goal, they need a large hacker community around the world. Therefore, hackers invite an international film crew from AmericaTomorrow to shoot a documentary... Sorry, I'm not making a documentary about ourselves.
